summary: Key Dates only: registration windows, the Dec 6 board meeting, and gear return; the empty month grid is gone. Why: the grid sat blank and needed a sideways scroll on phones.

sources.fact: Board motion passed Nov 1: Spring 2027 registration opens with a Black Friday sale Nov 27 to 29, $50 off per family; Early Bird Nov 30 to Dec 31, $25 off per family; full price Jan 1, 2027.

later: President (Ramey Harguess) with VP of Baseball (Jeremy Olsen) and VP of Softball (Luke Kress): the 2027 key dates to add as a short list under the registration card and to load into the Sports Connect calendar (registration close, evaluations, draft, coaches meetings, DICK'S weekends, Opening Day, picture day, Rainiers night, All-Star start); nothing for 2027 is posted yet.

Information Officer (Melissa Olsen): who keeps the Sports Connect calendar up to date this season? It is empty today; the Nov 27 registration opening, Nov 30 Early Bird start and Jan 1 full price date should go in first.
Website (Daniel Grande): on Nov 27 the card's button reads 'Register'; after Dec 31 the Black Friday and Early Bird lines come off; add the next key dates as they are set.

long_summary: Key Dates is one card: Spring 2027 registration opens Fri Nov 27, a full-width Registration button (Register from Nov 27), and the three windows (Nov 27 to 29 Black Friday, Nov 30 to Dec 31 Early Bird, Jan 1 full price) as lines inside it with no dollar amounts; those live on the Registration page. Cut under Coach's 11/4 audience standard: the Nov 7 gear return (a coach task, Coach Run Book), the Dec 6 board meeting (board business), the separate Early Bird and full-price cards, and the empty 'Season dates' placeholder. The blank Sports Connect month calendar stays off the page.
